scope: Read-only reaggregation of four saved campaigns; targeted source and trace audit; no new model runs.
scoring: Existing strict comparator: exact dict key set and list order, absolute numeric tolerance 1e-4; parser accepts Python literals and numeric strings.
cost: Recorded repository accounting estimates, not invoices; engine/storage excluded. Per-task usage cannot certify that every failed provider attempt has usage.

baseline_state.behavior: Both arms reuse one agent; reset is false after task 1. Installed LocalPythonExecutor.send_variables calls state.update and does not clear existing variables. coderetain adds snapshots, retained(task,name), and prompt index; it does not enable basic state persistence.
baseline_state.executor_probe: LocalPythonExecutor: set marker=[7]; send_variables({}); send_tools({}); append(8). Result [7,8]. No model calls.
